SELECT inquiry_no, inquiry_title, TO_CHAR(inquiry_created, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시"MI"분"') AS inquiry_created, inquiry_status FROM ( SELECT inquiry_no, inquiry_title, inquiry_created, inquiry_status, ROWNUM AS rn FROM ( SELECT inquiry_no, inquiry_title, inquiry_created, inquiry_status FROM tbl_inquiry WHERE customer_id = #{customer_id}
ORDER BY inquiry_no DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{pageNum} * #{amount} ) WHERE rn > (#{pageNum} - 1) * #{amount}

SELECT inquiry_no, inquiry_title, customer_id, TO_CHAR(inquiry_created, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시"MI"분"') AS inquiry_created, inquiry_status FROM ( SELECT inquiry_no, inquiry_title, customer_id, inquiry_created, inquiry_status, ROWNUM AS rn FROM ( SELECT inquiry_no, inquiry_title, customer_id, inquiry_created, inquiry_status FROM tbl_inquiry
ORDER BY inquiry_no DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{pageNum} * #{amount} ) WHERE rn > (#{pageNum} - 1) * #{amount}
